meta.title: Near neighbors: reached groups nearest to each unreached group, on the E-scale
meta.grain: rows = one per people group x country (peoplegroups.org grain), columns in cols; dictionary columns hold an index into dict[col]. links[u] = [reachedRow, eLevel, km, samePeople] for unreached row u
meta.framework: Ralph D. Winter's E-scale (E-1 same language and culture, E-2 near culture, E-3 distant culture) and P-scale, Lausanne 1974. Levels here are PROXIES from language code and the IMB people taxonomy, not field assessments.

rules.e1: same LanguageCode (ISO 639-3); samePeople = same ROP25 ethne in another country
rules.e2: different language, same ROP2 people cluster, or same LanguageFamily within the same ROP1 affinity bloc
rules.e3: none of the above, within 600 km or in the same country
rules.p: P-level of an unreached group = the smallest E-level any reached neighbor reaches it at
rules.rings: columns ring + ringNb on every row (ring 0 = reached, the centre; ring -1 = unreached with no relation, unplaced; ringNb -1 = none). 1-3 same LanguageCode, 4-6 same LanguageName root (text before the comma), 7-9 same LanguageFamily, each x culture same ROP25 / near ROP2 / different; 10 = same country or within 600 km. Closest = lowest ring, then believers / (1 + (km/500)^2). Rule: src/rings.js
rules.rank: inside one E-level: stronger match kind first (E-2: people cluster before language family), then estimated believers / (1 + (km/500)^2)

meta.believersEst: Population x midpoint of the evangelical band: an order of magnitude for sizing an audience, not a count
meta.bridgeRule: bridges = languages spoken by at least one reached AND one unreached group; reached/unreached = row indexes; res = [bible, film, audio, radio] available in that language for any of them; ranked by unreached population
